# Southern Charm Ranch

> Rustic-elegant barn wedding and event venue in Keystone Heights, Florida. "Where every celebration begins with Southern Charm."

Southern Charm Ranch is a rustic-elegant venue designed for life's most meaningful celebrations: an open-air timber barn with crystal chandeliers, Bridal & Groom Suites, and open pasture grounds.

## Events hosted
Weddings; bridal showers; baby showers; birthdays and special events; gender reveals, sprinkles and more; corporate events.

## Wedding season packages (starting prices)
- Peak Season (March-May, October-November), "Our Most Popular Time": from $4,500
- Value Season (February, September, December), "Beautiful & Budget Friendly": from $4,000
- Off-Peak Season (January, June-August), "Intimate & Affordable": from $3,500
Every wedding package includes: entire day rental of the barn & outdoor event space; Bridal & Groom Suites; tables & chairs; parking; on-site restrooms; exclusive use of the property.
Introductory pricing is available for a limited time. Holiday weekends and select dates may be subject to premium pricing.

## Private event packages (starting prices)
| Package | Mon-Thu | Fri & Sun | Saturday |
|---|---|---|---|
| Good: 3-hour celebration | $500 | $700 | $900 |
| Better: 6-hour celebration (most popular) | $700 | $900 | $1,100 |
| Best: 8-hour celebration | $900 | $1,100 | $1,300 |
Every package includes exclusive use of the barn and outdoor event space, tables & chairs, restrooms, parking, 1 complimentary hour for setup and 1 complimentary hour for cleanup. Weekend packages depend on venue availability and existing wedding reservations.

## Optional enhancements
Additional event time $125/hour; cleanup service $200; Decorating Package, Fire Pit Package, Yard Games and Coffee Bar (ask for pricing).
